strings.SCATTER_RULE_1: SCATTER appears on reels 2, 3 and 4 only.
strings.WILD_RULE_1: WILD appears on reels 2, 3 and 4 only.
strings.WILD_RULE_2: WILD thay thế cho tất cả các biểu tượng trừ SCATTER.
strings.RULES_1: Minimum bet is 25 credits playing 25 lines.
strings.RULES_2: All wins begin with leftmost reel and pay left to right on adjacent reels.
strings.RULES_3: WILD substitutes for all symbols except SCATTER.
strings.RULES_4: Total bet is 25 coins multiplied by bet multiplier.
strings.RULES_6: SCATTER appears on reels 2, 3 and 4 only.
strings.RULES_7: WILD appears on reels 2, 3 and 4 only.
strings.RULES_8: Chỉ tổ hợp chiến thắng cao nhất mới được trả thưởng.
strings.RULES_9: Sự cố chức năng hủy tất cả các khoản thanh toán.
strings.BASE_GAME_WILD_COLLECTION_BONUS_1: During normal game only, any WILD on reels 2, 3 and/or 4 are collected above their corresponding reels.
strings.BASE_GAME_WILD_COLLECTION_BONUS_2: Once 3 WILD are collected on the reel, the next three games will contain 3 wilds for spin 1, 2 wilds spin 2 and 1 wild on spin 3.
strings.BASE_GAME_WILD_COLLECTION_BONUS_3: During the feature, WILD can be collected on the other reels.
strings.BASE_GAME_WILD_COLLECTION_BONUS_4: All Wilds collected are reset after the feature.
strings.BASE_GAME_WILD_COLLECTION_BONUS_5: Total bet is the same as the game that triggered the Bonus.
strings.FREE_GAMES_TITLE: Tính năng Ván Chơi Miễn Phí
strings.FREE_GAMES_2: The reels expand to 5 symbols high and 40 lines are active during the free games feature.
strings.FREE_GAMES_3: During the free games, SWILD can appear on reels 2,3,4. It is treated as a WILD. SWILD expands vertically to fill the reel with WILD.
strings.FREE_GAMES_4: Wilds added by SWILD will move 1 position down each spin. These WILDs do not add to the Wild Collection.
strings.FREE_GAMES_5: SWILD can expand on top of another SWILD. These can stack per position.
strings.FREE_GAMES_6: During the free games, XWILD can appear on the reels. When it lands, it will either 'add extra wilds', 'change wilds to sticky wilds' or 'add multipliers to wilds'.
strings.FREE_GAMES_7: The XWILD symbol itself is added to the Wild Collector.
strings.FREE_GAMES_8: If an XWILD 'adds extra wilds', these wilds are added to the wild collector above.
strings.FREE_GAMES_9: If a WILD would be added onto a position with a WILD already on it, the multiplier increases.
strings.FREE_GAMES_10: Base Game Wild Collection is disabled during the free games.
strings.FREE_GAMES_11: The free games remaining counter does not go down while the Free Game Wild Collection bonus is active.
strings.FREE_GAMES_12: Total bet is the same as the game that triggered the Free Games Feature.
strings.FREE_GAME_WILD_COLLECTION_BONUS_1: During free games only, WILD or SWILD on reels 2, 3 and/or 4 are collected above their corresponding reels.
strings.FREE_GAME_WILD_COLLECTION_BONUS_2: Once 5 or more WILDs are collected on the reel, the next five games will contain 5 wilds for spin 1, 4 wilds spin 2, 3 wild on spin 3, 2 wild on spin 4 and 1 wild on spin 5.
strings.FREE_GAME_WILD_COLLECTION_BONUS_3: During the feature, WILD can be collected on the other reels.
strings.FREE_GAME_WILD_COLLECTION_BONUS_4: All Wild collected are reset after the feature.
strings.FREE_GAME_WILD_COLLECTION_BONUS_5: Total bet is the same as the game that triggered the Bonus.
strings.BUY_FEATURE_1: Playing Buy Feature will trigger the Free Games Feature.
strings.BUY_FEATURE_2: Buy Feature is played at 80x the player's total bet.
